full_details: You ate three bites before the play and said you were not ill. The penny loaf is still a finger short, measured on Friday. Board is threepence. At the desk you left four men on a sheet and did not find how to bring them on. At two the yard was full. You had a speech at each end and a stool between. You came off well. At the Burbages' the bean fell to Nick. He set Kemp a paternoster, Heminges no Item till morning, and Sam the last slice. Kemp lasted about half the prayer. James said twenty-one years, and two to run, and Cuthbert moved the jug. The Admiral's men are at Greenwich again tonight, and nobody minds. Heminges gave the holiday boxes as eleven pound eight shillings to the sharers' side, without a drum or a trumpet, then said Item and lost a slice to Sam. At home Mistress Ansell had kept a slice of her own cake, and stood over you while you ate it.
one_sentence: You played Errors to a full yard, and at Holywell the bean made Nick king for the first time.
title: Played Errors to a full yard, and the bean made Nick king
